Script execution failed: [Errno 63] File name too long: '/Users/neosteinhoff/.hermes/scripts/#!/bin/bash
# Hermes → Zeg real-time bridge watcher
ZEGLAST="/tmp/zeg_last_seen.txt"
ZEGHOOK="http:/localhost:8700/api/webhook/hermes"

# Get current Hermes sessions
SESSIONS=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 3 "http:/localhost:8502/api/sessions" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    sessions = json.load(sys.stdin)
    for s in sessions:
        sid = s.get('id','')
        ended = s.get('ended_at') is not None
        status = 'ended' if ended else 'active'
        print(f'{sid}:{status}')
except:
    pass
" 2>/dev/null)

# Get current Zeg health
zeg_health=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 3 "http:/localhost:8700/api/health" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('healthy') if d.get('status')=='ok' else print('down')" 2>/dev/null)

if [ -f "$ZEGLAST" ]; then
    prev=$(cat "$ZEGLAST")
else
    prev=""
fi

# Write current state
echo "$SESSIONS" > "$ZEGLAST"

# Detect new/ended sessions and send webhooks
echo "$SESSIONS" | while IFS=: read sid status; do
    if [ -z "$sid" ]; then continue; fi
    prev_line=$(echo "$prev" | grep "^$sid:" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$prev_line" ]; then
        curl -s --connect-timeout 2 -X POST "$ZEGHOOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d "{\"type\":\"session_started\",\"data\":{\"session_id\":\"$sid\"}}" > /dev/null 2>&1
    elif echo "$prev_line" | grep -q ":$status$"; then
        : # unchanged
    else
        curl -s --connect-timeout 2 -X POST "$ZEGHOOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d "{\"type\":\"session_${status}\",\"data\":{\"session_id\":\"$sid\"}}" > /dev/null 2>&1
    fi
done

echo "Bridge tick: Zeg=$zeg_health, sessions tracked=$(echo "$SESSIONS" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"'
